snippet.title: Night Plane - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam! ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310570/Night_Plane/

Night Plane is a thrilling airborne hospitality simulator that costs way less than a plane ticket! It's your first night on the job: Board passengers, assist with their struggles, and resolve emergencies all by yourself. Also, please don't let the psychopomp fly the aircraft.
